policy: strict historical Test exclusion; user explicitly confirmed
initial_variants: LR/SVM: standard-none, standard-balanced, robust-none; RF: none, balanced
tuning: Per-family initial Validation winner fixes scaler/weight; LR C=.1/10; RF trees=200 or depth=12,leaf=3; SVM C=10 or gamma=.001
ranking: Exclude non-Toluene mean F1 drop > .03 vs strict family baseline. Within .01 macro-F1 of eligible best, prefer Toluene F1, recall, other-five F1, macro-F1, then fixed trial order.
finalists: One Validation-selected representative per family retained jointly: only 4 Validation Toluene.
priority: Highest representative Validation macro-F1, then Toluene F1; exploratory priority only.
stability: Validation is one Batch: stability unavailable for selection. Test SD descriptive only.
expansion: No new expanded-Batch fitting: impossible under strict historical Test exclusion. Frozen original B_early vs B_history comparison only.
evaluation: Exploratory; all existing Test periods already observed in prior stages.
